A type of '''starship''' was used as a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] and [[Warship/Legends|warship]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and subsequent [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. One such ship carried Imperial forces to the surface of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Alderaan Civil War]],<ref name="SWTOR" /> and a number of them accompanied [[Darth Marr]] on his expedition into [[Wild Space]] at the close of the war.<ref name="KOTFE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref> Several ships of the same class were part of the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance's]] fleet.<ref name="KOTET" />
